node.statement: Approximate left multiplication estimate from def-epsilon-cstar-algebra and def-approximate-unitary-space: for U in calU, U^dagger bold-dot U=J and ||J||=1. The lower C*-inequality gives ||U||=||U^dagger|| <= (1-epsilon_r)^(-1/2), and the product inequality gives ||L_U||,||L_{U^dagger}|| <= (1+epsilon_r)||U||. The associator axiom and exact unit give ||L_{U^dagger}L_U-I|| <= epsilon_r||U||^2 <= epsilon_r/(1-epsilon_r). For epsilon_r <= 1/4 this is <1, so the Neumann lemma and finite dimensionality make L_U invertible and give ||L_U^{-1}|| <= (1-epsilon_r/(1-epsilon_r))^(-1)*(1+epsilon_r)*(1-epsilon_r)^(-1/2). These displayed scalar functions are at most 1+K*epsilon_r on [0,1/4] for a universal K, and the same is true of ||L_U||.
